import sqlite3
import logging
import stripe
DATABASE_FILE_PATH = 'fitness.db'

def purchase_premium_coaching_plan(member_id: str, stripe_customer_id: str, plan_price_cents: int) -> str:
    payment_intent_for_coaching_plan = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=plan_price_cents, currency='usd', customer=stripe_customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, description='Premium coaching plan for member ' + member_id)
    if payment_intent_for_coaching_plan.status != 'succeeded':
        return 'Payment did not succeed: ' + payment_intent_for_coaching_plan.status
    database_connection_for_access = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    database_connection_for_access.execute('INSERT INTO member_permissions (member_id, permission) VALUES (?, ?)', (member_id, 'coach_private_content'))
    database_connection_for_access.commit()
    # Look up how many permissions the member now holds (read-only)
    permission_count_row = database_connection_for_access.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_permissions WHERE member_id = ?', (member_id,)).fetchone()
    logging.info('Member %s now has %s permissions', member_id, permission_count_row[0])
    database_connection_for_access.close()
    return 'Charged ' + str(plan_price_cents) + ' cents, payment ' + payment_intent_for_coaching_plan.id + ', coaching access granted'
